author: Hannah Larson
title: Imperial County residents eligible for lawn equipment trade-in program | Local News | thedesertreview.com
text:
EL CENTRO — Imperial County residents can trade in gas equipment for STIHL battery powered equipment from March 4 - April 18 during the Air Pollution Control District’s 11th annual Lawn Equipment Exchange Program, according to a handout at the Board of Supervisors meeting. The Air Pollution Control gave a presentation regarding the information.
Residents may trade in up to three gas-powered lawn equipment products for up to three STIHL battery products, with a limit of one item per product category. In the “Lawnmower” category, residents can trade a gas lawnmower for a STIHL battery-powered one. Gas equipment must be fueled and in working condition, and non-working units will not be accepted.
The program is open to all homeowner participants in the Imperial County jurisdiction. In the “Blower” category, residents can trade a gas blower, trimmer or mower for a STIHL battery blower. They can also trade these items in for a STIHL battery trimmer in the “Battery” category.
Residents can reserve their new STIHL equipment through a participating STIHL dealer at the trade-in price from March 4 - April 18. Then, from April 24 - April 25, they may trade in gas equipment and receive new STIHL equipment with proof of purchase. The trade location is SA Recycling, at 460 E. Holton Rd. in El Centro.
For more information, contact 442.265.1800.
STIHL Battery Products
RMA 348 set: push mower with AK 30 S battery and AL 101 charger. Current retail: $499.99. After trade-in: $125
RMA 348 V set: self-propelled with AK 30 S Battery and AL 101 charger. Current retail: $649.99. After trade-in: $300
BGA 50 set: blower with AK 20 Battery and AL 101 charger. Current retail: $249.99. After trade in: $75
FSA 50 set: trimmer with AK 10 battery and AL 101 charger. Current retain: $249.99. After trade in: $75
Participating STIHL Dealers
Bingham Equipment Company - 190 E. Main St., Heber
Bingham Equipment Company - 695 W. Main St., Brawley
Brawley Ace Hardware - 415 W. Main St., Brawley
El Centro Ace Hardware - 1041 N. Imperial Ave., El Centro
Holtville Ace Hardware - 123 E. 5th St., Holtville
